authorization.text: On 2026-10-11 the owner instructed in the controlling session: "do all. complete all work. merge to main. clean worktrees." after being offered the #426 audit shortlist (https://github.com/netbka/Dyk/issues/426#issuecomment-6107132436) and the open #485 review findings and PR-review follow-ups. Basis: the chat instruction from the owner quoted above (given in the controlling session, not recorded on GitHub until the controller posts it on Dyk #426), which explicitly asks for the offered work to be done and merged; the controller treats it as the owner approval that D-040 requires for the audit presentation changes, including removals and the moved prompt. Every visible change is represented in Storybook in the same PR and independently reviewed before merge; bounded repairs also follow Dyk AGENTS.md section 4. constraints: No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions, paid services, or Playwright and other browser-driven tests (Dyk owner rule). Local disposable SQL only through the repository runners (npm run test:sql / npm run journeys with a selected scope) when a task changes a route or persistence; never the production database.

Keep the affected Storybook stories in sync with every renderer change (Storybook is not post-hoc documentation). RU/EN/HE, true Hebrew RTL, 320/390 widths, 44px hit areas, no horizontal overflow, truthful states (T2).
Never read .env contents, credentials, private conversations or real user data; fixtures are synthetic.
A Storybook build or passing tests is not visual acceptance; each PR lists the story ids for independent visual review and states that the visual verdict is pending.

Do not remove worktrees, delete branches or link another checkout's node_modules. Do not add any new blocking gate, lock, required approval or check that depends on owner-provisioned keys, credentials or setup (Dyk AGENTS.md section 4).
Never weaken an existing test, guard or assertion; never add a capability outside the accepted feature map unless the task names the owner decision that adds it.

Only this campaign edits the auth-web escaping guard, app/public/parent-ui.js sheet rendering, the task deletion path and one new migration; other concurrent campaigns own Master/Setup (storybook/src/master-overview.js, design Master stories, setup-view), Chats (chats-page-ui, chat-reader, Chats stories), Tasks/Assistant (task-card, task-board-ui, assistant.js), Profile (profile-page-ui, connection-card-ui) and safety tooling; do not edit their files beyond a one-line import if unavoidable.
